response.sql: WITH staff_revenue AS (SELECT p.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount FROM payment AS p WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.staff_id) SELECT staff_id, total_amount, total_amount / SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM staff_revenue ORDER BY staff_id;

assumptions.assumption: Revenue is attributed to the staff member recorded on the payment.

alternatives.interpretation: Attribute each payment to the staff member recorded on its linked rental.
alternatives.sql: WITH staff_revenue AS (SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY r.staff_id) SELECT staff_id, total_amount, total_amount / SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM staff_revenue ORDER BY staff_id;
